note: JJ — one clip, C0001.MP4, filling the whole 12-minute timeline. No match and no trims: those spread a graph across a timeline, and there is nothing here to spread it to. Build six nodes on C0001 (Alt+S five times), run this, done. Selected by name_contains so extension and letter case do not matter.

nodes.label: 01 BALANCE
nodes.note: Neutral to start. The room's white balance is already close, so this stays a handle rather than a correction — turn it only if a section of the take drifts.

nodes.label: 03 LOOK
nodes.note: jj_c0001.cube, built for this footage. golden_hour.cube came from the sunset reference image and does not belong on an interior: it hazes the blacks up from 0.07 to 0.11 and warms the blue curtain by 30%.

nodes.label: 05 WINDOW - subject, add by hand
nodes.note: Off deliberately. There is no sky in this shot — the useful window here is a soft one on her, or a vignette pulling the band back. A window cannot be scripted, so the node waits in the right place in the chain.
